items.title: Data Consistency & Transactions
items.description: Patterns for maintaining data consistency in distributed systems including database transactions, eventual consistency, the outbox pattern, idempotency, and conflict resolution.

items.title: Transactional Outbox Pattern
items.description: A complete guide to the Transactional Outbox Pattern, solving the Dual-Write Problem, schemas, Spring Boot implementation, polling publishers (SKIP LOCKED) vs. Change Data Capture (CDC via Debezium), and comparisons.
